edits.before: This book follows a hundred of those roads. Its subject is the wider world that becomes visible when we pay attention to fermentation.
edits.after: This book follows a hundred of those roads.

edits.before: The discoveries here are often small enough to hold in your hand. A closure can reveal a changing distribution system. A ration tablet can show what an administrator needed to record. Three tasting glasses can explain why detecting a difference and preferring one sample are separate scientific questions. Sometimes the wider lesson is startling; sometimes it is the pleasure of realizing that an ordinary object has been complicated all along.
edits.after: The discoveries here are often small enough to hold. A bottle closure can reveal a distribution system; a ration tablet can show what an administrator needed to record. Three tasting glasses can explain why detecting a difference and preferring a sample are separate scientific questions.

edits.before: There is also pleasure in a good correction. An ancient poem can tell us about brewing without functioning as a recipe. A famous origin story can dissolve into the slower, more interesting history of institutions and equipment. The next analytical method can make an old archaeological sample answer a new question. Uncertainty is part of these stories because discovery depends on it. Researchers have to distinguish what they measured from what they inferred, and what remains beyond the evidence.
edits.after: There is pleasure in a good correction. An ancient poem can tell us about brewing without functioning as a recipe. A famous origin story can give way to the slower history of institutions and equipment. A new analytical method can make an old sample answer a new question. Discovery depends on distinguishing what researchers measured, what they inferred, and what remains beyond the evidence.

edits.before: Every lesson has a linked evidence note. These notes identify the relevant wiki articles and the principal underlying sources, including qualifications that would interrupt the narrative if repeated in every sentence. A publisher's abstract is described as an abstract. A museum's account is attributed to the museum. A field study stays attached to the people and places it actually studied. The production files provide a fuller source-to-chapter map for future corrections.
edits.after: Every lesson has a linked evidence note identifying wiki articles, underlying sources, and qualifications that would interrupt the narrative if repeated in every sentence. An abstract is described as an abstract; a museum's account is attributed to the museum. Field studies stay attached to their actual people and places. A fuller source-to-chapter map supports future corrections.

edits.before: You need not love beer to enjoy the questions. You do not need to drink it at all.
edits.after: You need not love or drink beer to enjoy the questions.

edits.before: For future maintenance, the production bundle includes a machine-readable source-to-chapter map, the frozen source commit, per-source access records, rebuild scripts, and an issue list. Researchers can strengthen a chapter without needing to reconstruct how its evidence was selected. The readable wiki links lead to the evolving site; the frozen commit identifies the evidence corpus used for this edition.
edits.after: A source-to-chapter map, access records, rebuild scripts, and an issue list support future maintenance. Wiki links lead to the evolving site; the recorded commit identifies this edition's frozen research corpus. Editors can strengthen a chapter while preserving how its evidence was selected.

edits.before: The original prose, editorial assembly, and cover were prepared with AI assistance. Responsibility for future publication choices, corrections, and licensing remains with the book's publisher and authorized rights holders.
edits.after: Future publication choices, corrections, and licensing remain the responsibility of the publisher and authorized rights holders.

edits.before: Those questions travel well. They work in a laboratory and at a dinner table, in an archive and in a field. They can make room for better evidence, a more accurate history, or a voice previously missing from the account.
edits.after: Those questions travel between laboratories and dinner tables, archives and fields. They make room for better evidence, more accurate histories, and voices previously missing from the account.
